resources.string: Turn on Wireless debugging automatically after this device starts
Turn Wireless debugging on or off right now. Turning it off disconnects any wireless ADB connection to this device.
This device does not look like a Meta Quest. These settings only work on Quest headsets.
Off pauses the guardian (boundary) and stays off after reboots. Quest usually only allows this over ADB; if it can\'t be changed here, use Meta Quest Settings in Dioxamine.
This headset only lets the guardian be changed over ADB. Use Meta Quest Settings in Dioxamine.
Off keeps the display on when the headset is taken off, and stays off after reboots. If nothing changes, use Meta Quest Settings in Dioxamine (it sends the same command over ADB).

Easiest: in Dioxamine on your phone or TV, connect to this device and use ADB tools → Install Wireless Debugging Helper (installs, grants and opens this app in one tap). Or run this from a PC, then tap Refresh:
Android only delivers the boot event to apps that have been opened at least once since install. Wireless debugging also needs a Wi-Fi connection.
